services.name: Fall Fishing
services.desc: From mid September to November fall is a great time for fly fishing on the Squamish River. The salmon run typically occurs during this season, attracting hungry trout and char. The exact timing can vary from year too year, but generally, late September to November is a prime time for fall fly fishing. The Squamish River hosts a variety of fish species, Rainbow trout, Bull trout, Cutthroat trout, Dolly varden, Chum and Coho Salmon. We provide all necessary fishing gear, as well as pickup and drop-off from your location in Whistler. Trips do not include lunch or a BC freshwater fishing licence. All trips are private. Dress weather appropriate for your trip day, comfortable clothes to fit
